  Three engagements: national competition platform in Go and Nuxt, a ministry

  React Native and Expo delivery in a remote Agile team.
- Earlier: curriculum content developer, Semarang State Polytechnic (Oct–Dec 2024).

## Projects

- Katresna Creations — https://katresna.web.id
  Digital service platform: Strapi content, Next.js SSR for search visibility,
  PostgreSQL, S3-compatible media, self-hosted Docker pipeline.
- Histora — https://github.com/denyryn/histora
  Browser extension that removes chosen pages from history as they load. Exact
  rules, local audit log, no telemetry, no network requests.
- Wecom — https://github.com/denyryn/wecom
  Points at any element on a page, leaves a comment, and exports a locator a coding
  agent can act on. Nothing leaves the browser.
- Authentia — https://github.com/denyryn/authentia
  TOTP authenticator extension: encrypted vault, encrypted backups, QR capture by
  framing the code on the page. Chromium MV3 and Firefox MV2.
- NDA client work (no public link): national competition platform (Go, Nuxt),
  ministry portal maintenance and features (Spring Boot), SatuSehat hospital
  integration (Laravel).
